# Scenario

`praise` is on the dated CRAN snapshot and is not in `epirhandbook-common`.
With network access, `pacman::p_load()` installs it during the render. With
`--network none`, the install fails and the call to `praise()` stops the
render.

```{r}
#| label: missing-package
pacman::p_load(praise)
praise::praise()
```
